proposals.tactic:
induction n with
| zero => exact ⟨2, by decide⟩
| succ n ih =>
  rcases ih with ⟨k, hk⟩
  refine ⟨k + 4 ^ n, ?_⟩
  change 4 ^ (n + 1 + 1) + 20 = 12 * (k + 4 ^ n)
  calc
    4 ^ (n + 1 + 1) + 20 = (4 ^ (n + 1) + 20) + 12 * 4 ^ n := by
      simp only [pow_succ]
      ring
    _ = 12 * (k + 4 ^ n) := by
      rw [hk]
      ring

induction n with
| zero => exact ⟨2, by decide⟩
| succ n ih =>
  change 12 ∣ 4 ^ (n + 1 + 1) + 20
  rw [show (4 ^ (n + 1 + 1) + 20 : Nat) = (4 ^ (n + 1) + 20) + 12 * 4 ^ n by
    simp only [pow_succ]
    ring]
  exact dvd_add ih ⟨4 ^ n, rfl⟩

have hp : ∀ m : Nat, (4 ^ (m + 1) : Nat) % 12 = 4 := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero => decide
  | succ m ih =>
    change (4 ^ (m + 1 + 1) : Nat) % 12 = 4
    rw [pow_succ, Nat.mul_mod, ih] <;> decide
apply Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero
rw [Nat.add_mod, hp n] <;> decide
